text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, ibuprofen is not on the FDA drug shortage list. Inventory varies across sites: Corvale East holds 211 tablets (15.3 days), Corvale General holds two lots totaling 1,019.39 units (23.1–30.2 days), and Corvale Lakeside holds 64 units (11.3 days). Consolidated days on hand are 15 days for East, 27 days for General, and 11 days for Lakeside.

Why (FDA record): The label for NDC 63629146804 identifies Bryant Ranch Prepack (FEI 1000519407) as the registered plant. FDA inspection 590126 at that plant ended on 2009-06-11 and was classified OAI, with the classification known on 2009-09-09. A Warning Letter was issued to the same plant on 2010-04-08. Subsequent inspections from 2010 through 2026 were classified VAI, most recently on 2026-07-16.

Our position: Supply is adequate at Corvale General but lean at Corvale East and Corvale Lakeside. No FDA shortage listing exists. The historical OAI and Warning Letter at Bryant Ranch Prepack are noted; recent inspections have been VAI.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to evaluate and qualify A-S Medication Solutions as an alternate source; requires P&T committee approval before purchasing.
2. Buyer to evaluate and qualify AFT Pharmaceuticals US, Inc. as an alternate source; requires P&T committee approval before purchasing.
3. Buyer to evaluate and qualify Advanced Rx Pharmacy of Tennessee, LLC as an alternate source; requires P&T committee approval before purchasing.
4. Buyer to evaluate and qualify Advanced Rx of Tennessee, LLC as an alternate source; requires P&T committee approval before purchasing.
5. Buyer to evaluate and qualify AiPing Pharmaceutical, Inc. as an alternate source; requires P&T committee approval before purchasing.

Not recommended: No immediate allocation changes or clinical protocol adjustments; those remain the purview of treating clinicians and the committee.
